title: What If You Could Visit a Neutron Star?

scenes.text: What if you visited a neutron star? Its tallest mountain is thinner than a hair.
It's a dead star squeezed into a ball about twelve miles across, with more mass than our Sun.
A single teaspoon of it would weigh about a billion tons. Roughly the mass of Mount Everest.
Gravity there is so strong that any bump gets crushed flat. Scientists think the highest mountain is under a millimeter.
It spins too. The fastest known one turns 716 times every second.
And escaping it would take over half the speed of light. A whole star's weight, in a city's worth of space.
